restrictions: Use only the fixed standard IV, steps 0 to 30 on every padded block, full feed-forward and the full 256-bit digest, on 128-byte messages followed by the fixed third padding block.

The construction is the published two-block attack of Li, Liu and Wang (eprint 2024/349, Section 4.2) using the characteristic of its Table 6, reproduced in proof.md. It is not a new attack and was not executed for this package.
Draw each first block from fresh independent uniform random coins for at most 2^49.3 trials. Verify any returned pair by complete re-hashing and require distinct messages.
Preprocessing is inside total time. Table enumeration is charged at one compression per record. Nonuniform advice is zero.
No experiments, computed witness or precomputed collision is used. The bound is a transcription of published analysis with the cost model's pricing applied.

heuristics.statement: One SAT/SMT starting point for the Table 6 characteristic expands to 2^48 valid solutions of (A_i) for -3<=i<=12, (E_i) for 1<=i<=12 and (W_i) for 5<=i<=12.
heuristics.scope: The single characteristic of Table 6 and one starting point, as analysed in eprint 2024/349 Section 4.2.
heuristics.extrapolation: The counts 2^14, 2^23, 2^27 and 2^25 for (W5..W8) and the experimental 2^11 pairs (W7,W8) are taken from the paper and not re-measured here.
heuristics.limitations: If the true count were 2^47 the cost would rise by about 0.6 bits and the claimed bound would fail. The 2^11 figure is an experimental count in the source.

heuristics.statement: After a table match, the free words (W13,W14,W15) satisfy the remaining conditions on (E13,E14,E15,W16,W18) with probability about 2^-1.3.
heuristics.scope: Matches produced by the construction for the Table 6 characteristic.
heuristics.extrapolation: The value 1.3 is the paper's estimate from 100 tests. It is extrapolated to the whole attack without re-measurement.
heuristics.limitations: A 100-test estimate has wide error. A true gamma of 2 would raise cost by a factor 2^0.7 and break the claimed bound.

heuristics.statement: The 96-bit values (A-3,A-2,A-1) derived from fresh random first blocks behave as uniform values independent of the table, and the number of matches is close to Poisson.
heuristics.scope: The match phase over 2^49.3 trials against a table of 2^48 records.
heuristics.extrapolation: Uniformity of reduced-round chaining values is assumed for the whole range. No test is submitted.
heuristics.limitations: Deviation changes the success probability rather than the cost. The claimed 0.6 sits below the 0.632 given by the Poisson model.

heuristics.statement: A starting point for the Table 6 characteristic exists and its SAT/SMT search costs at most 2^45 target-compression equivalents.
heuristics.scope: One starting point, charged inside preprocessing.
heuristics.extrapolation: The paper reports T_model of about 2^31.7 and calls it negligible, without a defined unit. The allowance of 2^45 is a judgment about 2^13 times larger.
heuristics.limitations: The unit of the paper's figure is not defined. A much larger real cost would raise the total, though the allowance has about 0.05 units of the total reserved for it.
